explanation: In 1969 the opposition took Caetano’s invitation and campaigned under a loosened censorship. It got nothing: 133,000 votes against 980,000 and not one seat, in a system where a third of the vote in a city wins no representation. The withdrawal of 1973 is the conclusion the opposition drew from that experiment. The CDEs stood aside in 1973 because they had tested the opening and knew what it was worth. They had not stood aside in 1969.
